title: Flexibilität im Ausdruck
slide_intent: Allow controlled variation so the photographic language can fit its audience and medium.
strategic_value: DB can remain recognizable across polished corporate images and more direct social content.
demonstration: A collage spans controlled architecture and portraits through expressive people and work scenes, labeled from precise to spontaneous.
practical_value: Choose the appropriate degree of control while preserving the shared photographic attitude.

content_islands.name: Range explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the context-dependent flexibility statement above the collage.

content_islands.name: Expression range
content_islands.spec: Arrange imagery across the precise, expressive and spontaneous labels.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy says a common attitude can vary by message, medium and context without losing its characteristic view.
reference_purposes.Application: The collage maps expression to corporate communication, campaign formats and social media.
